dimensions.source: Measurements tab, read in Chrome 2026-10-26; w and d are the 6" diameter

notes: Rejected 2026-10-26 (F-03): opened as the cordless lamp for the living room's seats (the final audit found no seat with a lamp it can read by, and a floor lamp's cord would cross the heater), but its Measurements give 80 lumens at 2700 K: a glow for the table, not a reading light; the UPPLYST night light is 110 lm. Regular price $17.99; IKEA Family price $13.99 (22% off), valid Oct 7 to Nov 11, 2026. Page: "Rechargeable batteries are sold separately. The charging function of this product only works with rechargeable batteries. IKEA recommends LADDA 2450 mAh HR06 AA 1.2V. 4 pcs are required. USB-C cable and USB power adapter are sold separately." Features: dimmable, battery-operated, adjustable color, outdoor; 8 photos on the page. 3.2 stars (163). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY. Search 'rechargeable table lamp' at IKEA (2026-10-26) lists only portable glow lamps of this kind (NÖDMAST, IKEA PS 2026, TVÅMASTAD with an opal glass shade, F-21), so a cordless lamp bright enough to read by is sought at Amazon.
